title: Cloud Support Engineer
summary: A cloud support engineer helps customers or internal teams fix problems with servers, networks, access and services running on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, working through support tickets within agreed response times. They sit in a cloud provider's support team or a managed services team, and pass product bugs or deep issues to senior engineers.
dailyDuties: Pick up support cases and reply within the agreed SLA
Reproduce customer issues in a test account
Troubleshoot Linux or Windows virtual machines that will not start or connect
Debug DNS, VPC, security group and load balancer problems
Fix access errors caused by IAM roles and policies
Write clear case notes and escalate to the next tier when needed
Cover rotational shifts, including some nights and weekends
